title: Python Development for Odoo
tagline: Learn Python from zero, the language behind Odoo: variables, control flow, data structures, functions and object-oriented programming, with three mini projects.
description: No programming experience needed. You will install Python and a code editor, then learn the language step by step with short video lessons and a quick check after each one.

The course covers variables and naming rules, input and output, operators, conditions and loops, lists, tuples and dictionaries, functions, and an introduction to object-oriented programming. You will finish by building a calculator, a command-line to-do list and a number-guessing game, ready to move on to Odoo Development.
learningOutcomes: Install Python and set up a code editor
Use variables, data types, input and output
Control program flow with conditions and loops
Store and organize data with lists, tuples and dictionaries
Understand classes and objects, the foundation of Odoo models
whoItsFor: Complete beginners who want to start programming
Functional Odoo users who want to understand the technical side
Students preparing for a career in Odoo development
Anyone who needs Python basics before Odoo Development
requirements: A computer where you can install Python

curriculum.title: Object-Oriented Programming

projects.title: Calculator Program

projects.title: Number Guessing Game

faq.question: Do I need programming experience?
faq.answer: No. The course starts from installing Python.

faq.question: Why learn Python for Odoo?
faq.answer: Odoo is written in Python, and its models are Python classes. This course gives you the foundation you need before Odoo Development.

faq.question: Does this course cover the Odoo ORM?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on Python itself. You will use the ORM in Odoo Development.

faq.question: What comes next?
faq.answer: Odoo Development, where you build your first Odoo modules.
